pr_title: Return a customize error message in case re-auth is required.
pr_body:
`gcloud` might require re-authentication. This might be in the form of
username / password, or a touch of security key, or asking users to
launch browser session to google.com. So it's best to bail here and ask
user to run `gcloud auth login` manually to re-auth.

**What type of PR is this?**

/kind feature

**What this PR does / why we need it**:

See above or #96289.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

Fixes #96289.

**Special notes for your reviewer**:

Internal bug 169364378.

**Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?**:

```release-note
Better messaging in case `gcloud` requires re-authentication.
```

**Additional documentation e.g., KEPs (Kubernetes Enhancement Proposals), usage docs, etc.**:

```docs

```

issue_context.title: Better messaging when `gcloud` needs to re-authenticate
issue_context.body:
**What would you like to be added**:

A better message in case `gcloud` requires re-authentication.

**Why is this needed**:

The current error message is:

```
$ kubectl get pods
Unable to connect to the server: error executing access token command ""/usr/lib/google-cloud-sdk/bin/gcloud config config-helper --format=json"": err=exit status 1 output= stderr=Reauthentication required.
ERROR: (gcloud.config.config-helper) There was a problem reauthenticating while refreshing your current auth tokens: Reauthentication challenge could not be answered because you are not in an interactive session.
Please retry your command or run:

  $ gcloud auth login

to obtain new credentials.
```

I think it is too verbose, and wrong (when it says "retry your command").

review_comments: `gcloud auth login` will make me re-enter my password. I'd rather we pick a different command that just triggers the reauth flow.
There is not a universal command to reauth. Some reauth flows even require external tools such as web browsers. So `gcloud auth login` is the safest fallback in this case, albeit more involved.
I think the majority of usage for this provider is for OAuth clients, who can reauth without external tools, and I'd rather not train people to re-run `gcloud auth login` if they don't need to.
As long as this is still depending on `gcloud` to obtain access tokens, `gcloud auth login` is the command to run. See associated bug for current error message. This CL doesn't change that fact.

Sorry to go dark on this again. I would prefer to "fix" this in gcloud (e.g. give a better message when reauth is failing due to being called in a credential-helper). The change in this PR would definitely be helpful for a specific set of users, but I worry that it's too specific.
